supplementation of CO and sodium butyate did not affect carcass characteristics and quality of meat except meat cholesterol content of broilers.
dietary supplementation of cinnamon essential oil and sodium butyrates at the levels attempted did not influence the meat quality parameters except cholesterol content.
supplementation of CO and sodium buty rate in broilers diet did not alter carcass characteristics but decreased meat cholesterol content in birds.

the effects of CO and CSBs on carcass characteristics in broilers.
the effect of CO and CSBs on carcass characteristics of meat quality parameters of broiler chickens.
the effect of dietary supplementation of CO and sodium buty rate on carcass characteristics, meat quality, and muscle cholesterol level in broiler chicken.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the supplementation of 0.09% CSB in broilers diet did not affect the carcass characteristics or meat quality of broilers.
CO and CSB supplementation did not influence carcass characteristics and quality parameters of meat.
the supplementation of cinnamon oil at 500 mg/ kg diet along with coated sodium buty-rate at 0.18 % in broiler diet is a better choice to improve the meat cholesterol content in meat.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of CO and CSBs as feed supplements is not a viable alternative for the use of antibiotic growth promoters in broiler chicken.
CO and CSB supplementation at 0.18 and 0.18%, respectively, can be considered as alternative for antibiotic supplementation in broiler diets.
the CO and CSB supplementation at the levels attempted did not alter carcass characteristics and quality attributes of meat in broilers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
supplementation of CO and sodium butyate at different levels in broiler diets did not alter the meat quality parameters.
the supplementation of cinnamon oil at 250 mg and 500 mg/kg diet and sodium buty rate at 0.9 and 1.8% diet in broilers had no adverse effects on carcass and meat quality characteristics.
the supplementation of cinnamon oil or coated sodium butyate in broilers diet does not alter the carcasses characteristics and meat quality properties.
